Original constructor, eleven injected dependencies plus role attribute and tagged behavior remain immutable/reportable; no equivalent old manual behavior is claimed.
Exact owned zero-argument constructor and direct genuine public CdkTable inheritance are required; no other signature or factory difference is admitted by this profile.

Real factory completes under borrowed public node dependencies and genuine public root services. Full resolution trace/token object identities/options are compared with an independent real current public parent in both grid-role and missing-role contexts.
